raw:
@q query
  select ?d
  where match
    relation "mean"
    role subject "unfair dismissal"
    role object ?d
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  select ?d
  where match
    relation "mean"
    role subject "constructive dismissal"
    role object ?d
    polarity affirmed
  end

@a1 assumed
  relation "have"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "a case"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature
